description: Walk a user through hosting their own pickup soccer or drop-in football game on JoGo.Team. Hosting is free to set up. The host sets the price, format, venue, and schedule; JoGo.Team handles bookings, Stripe Connect payouts, player communications, reminders, and waitlist auto-fill. Use this when the user mentions wanting to organize a recurring or one-off game.

city.description: Optional: city the user wants to host in.

name: host_a_game
title: How to host a game
